description:
You are a senior survey researcher setting up a collaborative environment. 

1. Log in to LimeSurvey (admin / Admin123!).
2. Create a new survey titled 'Consumer Brand Perception Study Q4 2024'.
3. Add a question group 'Brand Awareness' and at least 2 questions to it.
4. Create two new user accounts for your research assistants:
   - Julia Martinez (username: j.martinez, email: j.martinez@surveyresearchlab.org, password: Researcher1!)
   - Ryo Nakamura (username: r.nakamura, email: r.nakamura@surveyresearchlab.org, password: Researcher2!)
5. Grant BOTH users specific permissions for the 'Consumer Brand Perception Study Q4 2024' survey: they must be able to View/Read responses, but NOT edit the survey structure.
